direction.camera: Guide attention with speed lines; use a deliberate hold, a measured approach and a stable payoff.
direction.composition: let the character silhouette and name share one decisive action line; keep one dominant focal hierarchy and legible supporting evidence.
direction.editing: Open with bold name; alternate proof and breathing room, then resolve with energetic cut.
direction.lighting: hard warm rim; preserve subject contour and separate it from the supporting field.
direction.materials: cel-shaded armor and graphic impact marks; actual material appearance comes from approved imagery or a real 3D asset.
direction.sound: Create a restrained rhythm around angular action; place licensed accents on intentional cuts and keep speech clear.
direction.typography: Use speed lines,bold name,impact pause,high contrast,angular action,energetic cut as hierarchy cues; keep display copy short and body copy readable at final delivery size.
